messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
When I went to go get him and tuck him into bed, I found him laying down on my bed half naked.

output.original_text: When I went to go get him and tuck him into bed, I found him laying down on my bed half naked.
output.joy: When I went to get him and tuck him into bed, I joyfully found him sprawled on my bed, relaxed and carefree!
output.sadness: When I went to get him and tuck him into bed, I sadly discovered him lying on my bed, half naked and alone.
output.fear: When I went to get him and tuck him into bed, I nervously found him laying down on my bed, half naked and unexpected.
output.anger: When I went to get him and tuck him into bed, I was furious to find him laying on my bed, half naked like that!
output.surprise: When I went to get him and tuck him into bed, I was shocked to find him laying down on my bed, half naked!
output.disgust: When I went to get him and tuck him into bed, I was disgusted to find him laying on my bed, half naked.
